rationale.intuition:
Regression lock for PR #295 + audit 'cross-contamination' finding: UCLA does NOT offer Early Decision. The entire UC system uses a single November 30 application window with no early round. A previous CDS-extractor wave wrote edAcceptanceRate=40, eaAcceptanceRate=50 to UCLA's row despite the source PDF literally stating 'no early decision and no early action plan' (data-integrity-audit.md → Cross-contamination section, severity BLOCKING). The fix corrected the seed (edAcceptanceRate=null) and the engine's roundMultiplier was already wired to detect hasEarlyDecision=false and return neutral.

This fixture asserts that an ED attempt at UCLA produces a probability essentially identical to RD (within ±3 percentage points). If the delta ever exceeds ±3pp, suspect (a) the fabricated edAcceptanceRate returned to the seed, (b) hasEarlyDecision flipped back to true on UCLA's row, or (c) the engine's no-ED guard was removed.
